Zini · Listen & Shadow 05

The Friday Report — reporting back, rebuilding trust
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
SCENE 1 · THE FINDINGS
👤 Autry
Thanks for getting back to us on time. So — what did you find?
제때 연락 주셔서 고맙습니다. 그래서 — 뭘 찾으셨나요?
💬 Zini
As promised, here's the full report.
약속드린 대로, 전체 결과 보고드립니다.
as promised — 약속한 대로 · report — 보고서, 보고
같은 패턴으로 — As promised, I brought the samples. · As promised, here are the photos. · As promised, I called you first.
💬 Zini
We got to the bottom of the uneven finish.
마감이 고르지 않았던 원인을 끝까지 찾았습니다.
get to the bottom of ~ — ~의 원인을 끝까지 밝히다 · uneven — 고르지 않은 · finish — 마감
같은 패턴으로 — We got to the bottom of the delay. · I got to the bottom of the smell in the fridge. · They got to the bottom of the billing error.
👤 Autry
And?
그래서요?
💬 Zini
It turned out to be the mold temperature.
원인은 몰드 온도로 확인됐습니다.
turn out to be ~ — 알고 보니 ~였다 · mold — 금형, 몰드 · temperature — 온도
같은 패턴으로 — It turned out to be a software issue. · It turned out to be my old classmate. · It turned out to be cheaper than I thought.
💬 Zini
The whole thing came down to one setting.
결국 설정 하나 문제였습니다.
come down to ~ — 결국 ~ 문제로 귀결되다 · setting — 설정 · whole — 전체의
같은 패턴으로 — It all came down to timing. · The argument came down to money. · The match came down to one point.
👤 Autry
One setting caused all of that?
설정 하나가 그걸 다 일으켰다고요?
💬 Zini
I'm afraid so. We've already adjusted it and checked every insole from that lot.
그렇습니다. 이미 조정했고, 그 로트 전량을 확인했습니다.
adjust — 조정하다 · insole — 인솔, 깔창 · lot — (생산) 로트, 묶음
같은 패턴으로 — We've already sent the invoice. · I've already eaten, thanks. · They've already left the office.
SCENE 2 · MAKING SURE IT DOESN'T HAPPEN AGAIN
👤 Autry
All right. How do I know it won't happen again?
알겠습니다. 다시는 안 생긴다는 걸 어떻게 믿죠?
💬 Zini
Going forward, every batch will be checked twice.
앞으로 모든 배치는 두 번 검사됩니다.
going forward — 앞으로는 · batch — (생산) 배치, 한 묶음 · twice — 두 번
같은 패턴으로 — Going forward, every order will be confirmed by email. · Going forward, every receipt will be saved. · Going forward, every call will be logged.
💬 Zini
And we ran a full check on the rejected lot.
그리고 반려된 로트는 전수 검사를 했습니다.
run a full check on ~ — ~를 전수 검사하다 · rejected — 반려된
같은 패턴으로 — We ran a full check on the second line. · I ran a full check on my laptop. · They ran a full check on the brakes.
👤 Autry
Every piece?
전부 다요?
💬 Zini
Every piece. You have my word that this stays fixed.
전부 다요. 이건 확실히 고쳐졌다고 책임지고 말씀드립니다.
you have my word — 제가 약속드립니다 · stay ~ — ~인 상태로 유지되다
같은 패턴으로 — You have my word that the date won't move. · You have my word that I'll be there. · You have my word that this stays between us.
💬 Zini
If anything comes up, you'll hear it from me first.
뭔가 생기면 저한테서 먼저 들으실 겁니다.
come up — (일이) 생기다 · hear from ~ — ~에게서 소식을 듣다
같은 패턴으로 — If anything comes up, call me anytime. · If anything comes up, we'll push the date. · If anything comes up, just text me.
👤 Autry
I appreciate that.
그렇게 해주시면 좋죠.
💬 Zini
We'd like a chance to win back your confidence with the next shipment.
다음 선적으로 신뢰를 되찾을 기회를 주시면 좋겠습니다.
win back — 되찾다 · confidence — 신뢰 · shipment — 선적, 출하
같은 패턴으로 — We'd like a chance to show you the new line. · I'd like a chance to explain. · We'd like a chance to work with you again.
👤 Autry
Let's see the next samples. Then we'll talk.
다음 샘플 봅시다. 그리고 다시 얘기하죠.
